title: Demo Source - Solar Cooking
source_text: Solar cooking research often studies reflector geometry, insulation, thermal storage, and cooking efficiency under different sunlight conditions. Student projects may compare temperatures reached by box cookers and parabolic cookers.

title: Demo Source - Water Quality
source_text: Water quality investigations commonly measure pH, turbidity, nitrate concentration, and microbial contamination. Research designs often compare water samples across neighborhoods and discuss public health implications.

title: Demo Source - Machine Learning Education
source_text: Machine learning education projects introduce supervised learning, data preprocessing, train test splitting, model evaluation, and ethical use of data. Simple classifiers can help students explore real world prediction problems.

title: Demo Source - Robotics Sensors
source_text: Robotics projects use sensors, microcontrollers, motors, feedback loops, and control algorithms. A typical high school robotics manuscript describes the design process, testing results, limitations, and future improvements.
